spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands from northwest to southeast with the large island in the southeast. Scattered white cumulus and cirrus clouds cover parts of the ocean and cap windward sides of islands, heavier in the northeast and east. Central and south-central ocean is relatively clear dark blue with some thin scattered low clouds and lighter sun-glint variation to the south. No distinct gray, brown, or off-white haze or smoke streak distinct from ordinary clouds is clearly visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: Kīlauea volcano is not erupting; the summit eruption in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused. Episode 53 ended at 1:23 a.m. HST on August 13.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in July, while the summit region showed patterns of slight inflation. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 57 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the July reporting period, after 94 in June. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
